Kontrol walkback jangkar

The controlled paying out of anchor chain in reverse (walkback) under power, used for precise anchor positioning or retrieval.

Questions and answers

What is Kontrol walkback jangkar?

In this glossary, Kontrol walkback jangkar refers to: The controlled paying out of anchor chain in reverse (walkback) under power, used for precise anchor positioning or retrieval.

How is Kontrol walkback jangkar used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Jembatan, mulai kontrol walkback jangkar dan keluarkan rantai perlahan untuk menempatkan jangkar secara tepat pada posisi yang ditentukan."

Definition

The controlled paying out of anchor chain in reverse (walkback) under power, used for precise anchor positioning or retrieval.

Operational example

Bridge, commence anchor walkback control and pay out chain slowly to lay anchor precisely on designated position.

Localized term

Kontrol walkback jangkar

Localized example

Jembatan, mulai kontrol walkback jangkar dan keluarkan rantai perlahan untuk menempatkan jangkar secara tepat pada posisi yang ditentukan.
